issue.title: autopilot_server vs 1.4.3 does not compile

comments.body:
Perhaps this could solve the first issue ( I have no prior experience with mavsdk whatsoever so just trying things out):
        //auto server_component = mavsdkTester.server_component_by_type(Mavsdk::ServerComponentType::Autopilot);
        auto server_component = mavsdkTester.systems()[0]; //?  
(but howto know that I go the correct server_component, and not the missionplanner or so)

Also:
MissionRawServer::IncomingMissionHandle does not exist anymore.
missionRawServer.unsubscribe_incoming_mission does not exist anymore.
Mavsdk::NewSystemHandle  does not exist anymore
mavsdk.unsubscribe_on_new_system does not exist anymore

The API has changed in MAVSDK `main`, breaking compatibility with v1.4.3 (the next release from `main` will be v2.0.0).

You should use the examples from tag v1.4.3, or compile MAVSDK `main` from sources and use it against the examples in `main`.

Does that make sense?

Hello Jonas, I was not aware that the 1.4 was another branch (just loaded the newest). Thanks for pointing that out to me . I want to add Autopilot to ROS2 robot  to be able to communicate with QGroundControl for mission planning in MAVSDK. What would be the recommended branch, main or 1.4?

main is for the latest refactorings towards v2.
v1.4 for now is probably recommended, unless you need things from main.
